thread:
alex (marketing): Heads up — we want to publish the release announcement Thurs. Need: changelog commit link, docs deep link for the new Dedicated quickstart, a short benchmark headline for social, webinar time + RSVP tag, and inbound routing mapping. Can eng/docs confirm by EOD? :clock1:
mei (eng): I can cut the changelog PR now. Canary numbers look stable but QA running. Will post commit once merged. No breaking admin APIs.
rufus (docs): I will add a docs anchor at /docs/serve/dedicated#quickstart and include the rollout notes. ETA 3:30pm PT.
nora (product): Messaging guardrail: use "up to" language and include measurement caveats (eval set, model variant). Add a line about fallback to smaller variants for reliability.
sam-sales: For routing: demo -> demo-queue, enterprise -> ae-team. What is the exact form field for ARR?
alex (marketing): Use field name "est_arr" and tag "release-q2-2026". Draft headline suggestion: "Up to 1.7x throughput on long-chat; p95 typically <200ms (512-token eval)." Acceptable?
nora (product): Slight tweak to "up to 1.6x". Keep the p95 phrasing and parenthetical caveat.
mei (eng): Canary raw numbers: p50=85ms, p95=165ms, sustained throughput ~1150 tok/s with batching (512-token eval). I'll add numbers to changelog PR and a short bench paragraph.
rufus (docs): Docs link ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/serve/dedicated#quickstart. Added API snippet and feature-flag note.
release-bot: scheduled window: 2026-05-23T17:00Z -> 2026-05-23T18:00Z (canary->global). Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/release-2026-05-23
alex (marketing): Webinar date options: May 23 10am PT or May 24 11am PT. Prefer May 23 to align with release day. Need registrant tag set to 'release-q2-2026'.
sam-sales: May 23 works. We will map est_arr to CRM filter and add tag.
mei (eng): Changelog PR merged. Commit permalink: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/5d7b9f1. I added feature flag dedicated_preview=true (expires 2026-06-07).
alex (marketing): Great. Pulling commit link into the blog draft and social. Drafting short benchmark line for social: "Up to 1.6x throughput on long-chat; p95 typically under 200ms (512-token eval)." Will circulate for quick sign-off.
nora (product): Approving final copy. Thanks everyone — will review the blog before publish.
alex (marketing): Will post announcement at 2026-05-23T17:05Z after release-bot indicates global complete. Ping in thread when ready. :rocket:
